hero.title: Kling 3.0 AI Video Generator
hero.description: Direct a single shot from text or first and last frames. This workspace exposes Kling 3.0 standard 720p and pro 1080p modes, optional sound, and five-, ten-, or fifteen-second takes.
hero.verdict: Choose Kling 3.0 when sound, camera movement and a controlled final frame matter. Start at 720p and five seconds; move to 1080p only after the motion works.
hero.source_note: Upstream capabilities can change. The preselected generator is the source of truth for the controls and product credit charge currently available here.

sections.title: Where Kling 3.0 fits best
paragraphs: Kling 3.0 is useful for shots where motion and sound need to be evaluated together: product reveals, short narrative beats, environmental action and social hooks with a clear camera move.

The workspace intentionally starts with single-shot mode. Kling's upstream multi-shot and element-reference systems add planning complexity and are not presented as product controls until they are implemented and tested end to end.
bullets: Use text-to-video for composition and camera exploration.
Use one frame to establish art direction and two frames to control the ending.
Disable sound when the edit will receive a separate soundtrack.
Use 1080p for a validated shot, not the first prompt experiment.

rows: Resolution maps to Kling's std/pro input.
Keeps cost and shot planning predictable.
Image-led shots follow the uploaded frame.
Changes both provider input and displayed product credits.
The product currently submits one prompt as one shot.

callout.title: No 4K product claim
callout.text: Kling documents a 4K upstream mode, but this workspace currently exposes only 720p and 1080p. An upscale or provider capability is not described as native site output.

sections.title: Write for motion, timing and sound

examples.label: Product reveal
examples.text: A matte-black field recorder sits on a rain-darkened studio table. Slow 30-degree orbit as a narrow warm light travels across the controls; small droplets vibrate with a low bass pulse. Crisp product geometry, restrained room tone, no text overlays.

examples.label: First and last frame
examples.text: Move naturally from the opening frame into the final composition. The cyclist crosses the wet intersection as the camera tracks left at street level; headlights bloom softly in the rain, stable bicycle and rider anatomy, realistic traffic ambience.

rows: Reference-led shots and longer established controls
Flexible aspect ratios and prompt expansion

faqs.question: Is Kling 3.0 usable in this generator now?
faqs.answer: Yes. Kling 3.0 is preselected in the generator above. You need an account with enough credits.

faqs.question: Does Kling 3.0 generate sound here?
faqs.answer: Sound is an optional product control for Kling 3.0. The generate button recalculates the site credit charge when it is enabled.

faqs.question: Can I upload first and last frames?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload one image for a start frame or two images for start and end composition. The uploaded frame determines aspect for image-led generation.

faqs.question: Is 4K available on this site?
faqs.answer: No. This product currently exposes 720p standard and 1080p pro output for Kling 3.0, even though upstream documentation also discusses a 4K mode.
